description: Free; spends nothing. Use the user's own image, video or audio file on this computer as a model input: pass its path, and this uploads the unchanged file to the user's private Raywake files in one call and returns url, kind, content_type and size_bytes. Put url unchanged into the model's matching image/video/audio URL input, then quote. Accepted: JPEG/PNG/WebP up to 25 MB, MP4/MOV up to 200 MB, WebM up to 100 MB, MP3/WAV up to 50 MB. Reads only files in the home folder or working folder (or RAYWAKE_UPLOAD_ROOTS), never hidden folders such as .ssh or .config. Never upload customer files to third-party hosts, and never shrink, re-encode or embed a file as base64/data URI to avoid uploading.

path.description: Path of one local file, absolute or relative to the working folder; ~ means the home folder.

name: upload_file
title: Upload a local file
